items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: I heard Henry “Red” Allen, I met Henry “Red Allen but I can’t say I knew him.

ctx.x: But later at a party he was sort of divorced and he had a wife in Canada and he had some children, teenaged children. And I remember they came to the house at the party that we had and I went back to the music room and got them to come and I put on “Preaching the Blues” or whatever it was, with the Luis Russell band. What’s the guy, I’ve forgotten what it’s — “The Call of the Freaks” and I said this is your father playing and I want you to know how good your father was. So I got them to listen to their own father…
Yeah. That’s pretty deep. Even the fact —
